Docs/Resources & release status

Resources & release status

Find official paper and code links and understand which execution artifacts are not public yet.

Official research records

  • DexArena on arXiv ↗ — preprint record, versions and manuscript metadata.
  • Read the public paper PDF ↗ — the manuscript hosted by arXiv.
  • SIPAIR-Elastic/DexArena on GitHub ↗ — the official public repository.
  • Citation — plain-text reference, supplied author order and copyable BibTeX.

Use the versioned arXiv record when referring to a particular manuscript revision. The current public repository is licensed under Apache 2.0; consult its license and any separate artifact terms when code, data or assets become available.

Public artifact status

ArtifactAvailable nowPractical consequence
PaperPublic arXiv preprintRead and cite the benchmark using arXiv:2611.02629.
RepositoryREADME, license and repository metadataCloning the current repository does not supply an executable simulator or the modules documented here.
Research task/runtime sourceNot present in the inspected public treeExecution examples require a separately available asset-complete research checkout.
Demonstration datasetPaper-reported; no public download URL suppliedThe 3,000-episode description is not a dataset download offer.
DexArena checkpointsNo public download URL suppliedCheckpoint commands use explicit local example paths.
Community intakeNot openUse the reproduction checklist for local comparisons.

Explore the benchmark on this site

  • Benchmark overview — task families and research figures.
  • Task catalog — complete sequences, canonical stages and success summaries.
  • Manuscript results — six-method comparisons and downloadable result tables.
  • Score protocol — evaluation units, aggregation and reproducibility requirements.
  • Collection previews — illustrative teleoperation recordings, not scored learned-policy rollouts.

Website illustrations and result exports help explain the research. They do not replace raw datasets, checkpoints or simulator assets for reproduction.

Locate interfaces in a research checkout

PurposeSource location
Canonical targetstask/config/collection_targets.py

Native-scene factoryutils/dex_scene_eval.py

These paths describe the verified research source layout; they are not links to files in the current public repository. Continue with Getting started when that source and its dependencies are available.
